evs.text: Welcome back, ninja! I'm so happy to see you.
Oh dear. Baron Muddle has been muddling up words.
First, let's read this word. Tap each sound, and say it with me.
Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
In Sound Swap, we change just one sound, to make a new word.
I'll show you first. Are you ready to watch? Tap the green arrow.
The first sound changes. Can you tap it, and kick it out?
Now you swap one. Do you want to have a go?
What do we need to change?
What do we need to change?
There's a slow way to say a word, and a fast way.
First, let's read this word. Tap each sound, and say it with me.
You fixed all of Baron's muddled words!
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, a gem! Each gem holds a way to spell a sound. When you get words right, it fills up.
Wow, you got everything right! Grown-ups, if this is too easy, you can jump ahead.
Next is a new game, called Ninja Run. Tap the glowing stone to play.
This game is called Ninja Run. Your ninja runs all by itself.
Tap anywhere to make your ninja jump. Can you try it now?
When the lanterns come, I'll say some sounds, and you catch the word.
Are you ready? Tap the green arrow, and off we go!
Here come the lanterns. I'll say the sounds of a word.
Tap the lantern with my word.
Let's say it the slow way...
Tap the lantern with my word.
You heard the word in the sounds.
Bong! You made it to the gong!
More stickers for your Sticker Book!
Look, these gems have filled a little more.
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
It's First Sounds again, with two new sounds.
Tap the petal, and say it with me.
I'll go first. Here's a nut and a hat.
Now watch my ninja write it.
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
The slow way has little gaps between the sounds.
Now you do one all by yourself.
Tap the petal, and say it with me.
And this is how we write...
Now you tap it, and say the sound.
Now you do one all by yourself.
Find the one that starts with...
Now it could be either sound. Listen carefully to my sound.
You listened right to the very start.
Which of these is the way we write...
Which of these is the way we write...
Next, we're going to build some words.
Now the last sound. Listen right to the end...
Let's say the sounds, the slow way...
Now tap the rabbit, and read the word fast.
Saying it slowly tells us which sound comes next.
Now you build one all by yourself.
Say the sounds, and read the word.
You listened for the first sound in every word, and you found how we write it.
Let's see what you won back from Baron Muddle.
Now let's go and see where your sounds live. Tap the green arrow.
You found some new sounds! Look, here are their petals, shining through the mist.
This is the way we spell it in man.
This is the way we spell it in pan.
Your World Flower is waiting for more sounds. Let's go and find them!
The glowing stone is your next game. Tap it when you're ready.
